title: team-review.js: make repeat runs no-ops by checking live requested reviewers from the API, not the event payload
answers: Why did re-running team review assign a third reviewer to the PR?
Why were review stats double-counted when the team-review workflow ran twice?
Where does the team-review script decide whether to skip assigning reviewers?
If I add a new reviewer-type exclusion to team review, where do I put it?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/team-review.js (the exported async handler run by team-review.yml) reads the PR's approvals, currently requested reviewers, and the stats file of team members (`loadStats` → `stats.reviewCounts`), then picks reviewers to assign to a PR.
Rule: Read requested reviewers with `github.rest.pulls.listRequestedReviewers` at run time rather than `context.payload.pull_request.requested_reviewers`, because the event payload is a snapshot taken when the run was triggered and does not show reviewers assigned by an earlier queued run. Then return early when any requested user is a team member (a key of `stats.reviewCounts`), excluding the Copilot task initiator (`copilotInitiator`). Requests for `Copilot` or non-team users must not trigger the early return.
Symptom: A re-run or queued duplicate of team review read stale requested reviewers, assigned an extra reviewer, and double-counted the stats for the same PR.
Constraints: The skip only applies when a team member is already requested. If a PR has only Copilot or outside reviewers requested, team review still assigns two reviewers. Any new exclusion should be added to the filter, not to the payload read.
applies: Reviewer selection in .github/workflows/team-review.js; applies to any change to how team review decides whether a PR already has reviewers.
says: Re-running the automated reviewer assignment assigned extra reviewers to my pull request.
Team review metrics are being double counted when reviewer assignment runs multiple times.
Automated team review should not assign additional reviewers if team members are already assigned.
Pull requests receive too many reviewers when review assignment triggers fire in close succession.
search: In .github/workflows/team-review.js, requested reviewers must be retrieved dynamically via github.rest.pulls.listRequestedReviewers rather than read from context.payload.pull_request.requested_reviewers. If any requested reviewer is a team member in stats.reviewCounts, excluding copilotInitiator, the script exits early to avoid assigning duplicate reviewers and double-counting stats during re-runs or queued executions. Requests for Copilot or external non-team users must not trigger the early exit, ensuring team review still assigns two reviewers unless an existing team member is already requested.
